method: Root-level review for suffix rules whose registrable root is itself advertising infrastructure. A per-host record beneath a root does not justify blocking the whole root - mi.gdt.qq.com does not justify DOMAIN-SUFFIX,qq.com - so each root here is reviewed on its own and states why no non-advertising service lives under it. app-us1.com was narrowed to its two reviewed hosts instead, because its www host resolves and the root could not be shown to be advertising-only. Roots carrying an advertising platform's delivery infrastructure are recorded with the seller domain that publishers actually declare, because a declaration names the company selling inventory and rarely the domain that delivers it - publishers declare google.com and the creatives arrive from doubleclick.net.
